claims: The attacks targeted Hezbollah command centers.
The attacks aimed to degrade Hezbollah's capabilities.
The attacks aimed to allow residents of northern Israel to return home.
The strikes were some of the largest in the conflict.
The strikes followed rocket fire from Hezbollah.
The strikes continued despite a separate US-Iran truce.
The IDF stated they are focusing on destroying Hezbollah infrastructure.
The IDF stated they are carrying out over 100 strikes in short periods.
The IDF stated [the strikes aim] to cripple Hezbollah's ability to fire rockets into Israel.
Israeli communities near the border have faced consistent rocket fire.
Israel and the U.S. stated that the ceasefire agreement with Iran did not apply to operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon.
Israel is expanding its air and ground actions against Hezbollah.
Israel's attacks on Lebanon in April 2026 are part of the ongoing 2026 Lebanon war.
The 2026 Lebanon war has displaced over one million people.
